last_batch.research: PubMed E-utilities searches covered 30 final fresh non-prescription menopause and hot-flash topics. The main query set returned 185 unique PubMed PMIDs, 185 fetched article records, and 185 abstracts available for inspection. Retained numeric effects or valid relative effects were verified for PMIDs: 22240636, 25982391, 34399063, 23625331, 31987231, 30056356, 24045673, 40194630, 35199638, 26784863, 39226408, 41217756, 26029989, 20625026, 35102099, 37192826, and 25932840. Seventeen retained references were new to the database. Fifteen new entries across fourteen qualified topics retain numeric intervention-versus-control results or valid relative effects; the two hops entries came from the same hops topic. Black cohosh, soy isoflavone, red clover, flaxseed, maca, and paced-respiration topics were linked to existing entries, with new supporting references attached to black cohosh and paced respiration. Sage, ashwagandha, shatavari, vitamin D, resistance exercise, aromatherapy, Mediterranean diet, soy food, probiotics, and black seed topics were screened out because the retrieved PubMed records did not provide a retained topic-specific numeric intervention-versus-control result or valid relative effect.
